rationale: Despite gapping up on a positive earnings catalyst, QMCO has suffered severe intraday selling pressure, falling below yesterday's close ($16.99) and trading well below session VWAP ($17.44). However, price is now extended near the bottom of its range (8.4%) and chopping right on the 5-minute 9-EMA ($16.18) with very thin 1-minute volume and a wide 55.6 bps spread. Neither a short entry in the hole nor a long entry against the prevailing intraday downtrend offers a favorable risk-to-reward profile once execution costs are factored in.
